title: German Braised Chicken in Polish Confit
description: A hearty German-inspired dish featuring tender chicken in a rich, umami-rich polish confit sauce.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the caraway seeds and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the polish confit, umami, bay leaves, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the pot to the oven and braise for 30-40 minutes, or until the chicken is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the chicken with the sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with fresh parsley, if desired.
